About me

Hi, I’m Snigdha! I’m a senior at NYU studying Economics & Data Science. I’ve grown up between India, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Seoul and now New York, and all that moving has shown me how differently people, places and businesses work around the world!

When I’m not behind my laptop working on something new, you’ll find me hunting down new food spots around the city, watching films, or taking pictures of my friends, family, food and the places I love.
